contract: reward(observation, action, next_observation, info) -> float for a MetaWorld task; a linear policy is trained with the cross-entropy method under the candidate reward. Score: success rate of the trained policy
notes: MetaWorld v3 (MuJoCo, CPU). The paper trains SAC/PPO for hours; this suite trains a linear policy with CEM for about a minute, so success rates are lower and comparable within the suite only.
protocol_description: Reimplemented in this repository from the paper's task description; instances are generated locally with a fixed seed, so scores are comparable within the suite but not with the paper's numbers.
name: sweep-into-v2
description: sweep-into-v2: optimize the candidate specified by the paper and evaluate against the named benchmark.
limitations: Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.

MuJoCo installation is manual per README. Repository shell script lists handle-pull-v2 but corresponding released reward file is absent; it is not included as a paper task (paper lists ten MetaWorld tasks).
No SPDX license identification verified for https://github.com/xlang-ai/text2reward.
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
